**✨ Feature release** · Obsidian 1.11.4+ · desktop & mobile

M.I.L.A now supports an `AGENT.md` instructions file in your Obsidian vault (similar to `CLAUDE.md` in Claude Code). Instructions are read dynamically on every turn and injected directly into the system prompt.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Dynamic AGENT.md support**: Place an `AGENT.md` (or `agent.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.agent.md`) note in your vault to define custom system instructions and behavior guidelines.
- **Fresh on every turn**: The file is re-read on every message turn in both Chat and Agent modes — any edits to your `AGENT.md` take effect immediately without restarting Obsidian or clearing caches.
- **Frontmatter stripping**: YAML frontmatter (`--- ... ---`) is automatically stripped, keeping only your markdown instructions in the prompt.
- **Palette Command**: Use `Open agent instructions (AGENT.md)` from the Command Palette (Ctrl/Cmd + P) to immediately jump to or scaffold your instructions file.
- **Configurable path**: Set a custom instructions path in Settings › Agent › Agent instructions file if you prefer a different location.

### 🔧 Fixes & Quality
- Fixed line-ending CRLF sensitivity in keyboard layout test suite on Windows.
- 20 unit tests added covering candidate path resolution, frontmatter stripping, dynamic turn reloading, and prompt injection.
